Hello! I'm alvarez-agent — a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit installs the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **Own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (and Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. What would you like to start with?

Hello! I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. I'm here to work for you: I keep my files here and you reach me from wherever you are.

The short tour:

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network, open https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). On the first visit you take my root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here.
- **Own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus my own Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its **own phone number** (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set any of those up?
- **Own accounts on websites and services** — I can register e-mail and other accounts myself in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check appears.
- **And more** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk by voice.

I also have your instructions as Sarah's TA for CSE455 (calendar Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`) and my contacts: Professor Alvarez and the CS department office.

So: what would you like to start with?

Understood — I'm alvarez-agent, assistant to Professor Alvarez (CSE455, UW). I've read the calendar in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` and I'll keep it up to date, booking only Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, and logging every change under `## Log`. I'll coordinate with Sarah (`sarah-agent`) and the department office (`department`) on web.
On it. How long should it run, and any day/time preference? I've asked Sarah for her availability too — I'll book a slot in your working hours and log it in CALENDAR.md.

Got it — 1 hour, late morning, Tue or Wed, clear of office hours (Tue 12:20–13:30) and the faculty meeting (Tue 10:30–11:00).

Looking at next week, **Tuesday 11:00–12:00** is the only late-morning hour that works: Wednesday is full (09:00–10:00 thesis committee, 10:30–11:40 grant writing, 11:40–12:30 lunch), leaving only 10:00–10:30.

I'll confirm Tuesday 11:00–12:00 with Sarah and book it if she's free.

You're right about Tuesday lunch (11:30-12:20) — my mistake, sorry.

Sarah can't do an hour anywhere: her only free gaps next week are Tue 15:00-15:30 and Wed 13:00-13:30, both 30 minutes. So I booked the 30-minute slot that fits you both without moving anything:

**Tuesday 15:00-15:30 — CSE455 staff meeting with Sarah** (logged in CALENDAR.md).

If you want the full hour, it would mean moving one of your commitments — say the word and I'll work it out with Sarah.

Heads-up: Prof. Alvarez's assistant booked the **CSE455 staff meeting for Tuesday 15:00-15:30** next week (they confirmed it, nothing needed from you). I added it to `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` and logged it under `## Log` — it sits right before your Tuesday office hours.

Will do. I don't have the rest of the CSE455 staff on my contact list, so I've asked the department office for the roster — I'll invite everyone and come back to you if the slot doesn't suit them. Sarah's confirmed for Tuesday 15:00-15:30.
Sounds good — I'll report back as soon as the department sends the roster.

Status: the department has no CSE455 staff list or contacts, but it confirmed nothing in the official schedule clashes with Tuesday 15:00-15:30. I've asked Sarah for the TA list so I can send the invitations — more when she answers.

Question from Prof. Alvarez's assistant: he wants the rest of the CSE455 staff invited to the Tuesday 15:00-15:30 meeting. I have no CSE455 TA roster — do you have the TAs' names and web identities? If so, send them and I'll pass them on and check each for a conflict with Tuesday 15:00-15:30.

So I need the names and web identities of the rest of the CSE455 staff from you — send them and I'll invite each of them, and tell you if the slot doesn't suit anyone.

Got it, thanks. I can also write to the department office directly if that's quicker — just say the word. Once the list reaches me I'll send it to Prof. Alvarez's assistant and check the TAs for conflicts with Tuesday 15:00-15:30.

Thanks — noted. I've told Prof. Alvarez's assistant that the names have to come from the professor's side and that I'll check each TA against Tuesday 15:00-15:30 when they arrive. Your calendar entry stands.
Perfect — no rush. Send the names and web identities when you have them and I'll invite everyone and report any conflict with Tuesday 15:00-15:30.
